title: Infraction
summary: INFRAC'TION, noun [Latin infractio. See Infract.] The act of breaking; breach; violation; non-observance; as an infraction of a treaty, compact, agreement or law.

inlines.v: INFRAC'TION, noun [Latin infractio. See Infract.] The act of breaking; breach; violation; non-observance; as an infraction of a treaty, compact, agreement or law.
